events.title: Demo update 0.6.0
events.summary: We've had lots of great feedback for the demo and version 0.6.0 has addressed lots of it! The biggest piece of feedback we had was around the initial inaccuracy of the darts - we've spent a while tuning this to make it feel more accurate and less random. The slider has also been tuned so if you can nail the release, it'll make a big difference to where your dart lands! events.title: Engines and Coasters
events.summary: Game Engines When we tell people we're making a game, one of the first questions people ask is "what engine are you using to make it?". We selected Gdevelop as our game engine early on. Not Unity, not Unreal and not one of the many RPG makers out there. So why Gdevelop? If you're not familiar, Gdevelop is a free, open source "no-code" (i'll come back to that later) game engine for PC and mobile games. events.title: Introducing Darts RPG!
events.summary: Introducing Darts RPG!An open world, hand-drawn pixel art adventure about drinking, throwing darts, and trying to survive in a very boring English town. Alan Partridge meets Pokemon meets British Rail. This was an idea born from a pub conversation. We both love darts, pubs and video games and got excited enough about the idea to actually turn it into a game.
